name: Loot Drops
author: salmun-nister
description: Watch Steam, Epic, GOG, and Amazon Luna for games that are free to keep, and get a desktop notification the moment a limited-time giveaway appears.

barWidget.description: Watch Steam, Epic, GOG, and Amazon Luna for games that are free to keep, and get a desktop notification the moment a limited-time giveaway appears.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to check the enabled stores. Giveaways usually run for days, so a short interval mostly buys noise rather than earlier news. Anything below about 90 minutes is rarely worth it; the panel also refreshes when you open it and the data has gone stale.

schema.label: Per-store notification limit
schema.description: How many new games a single store may announce individually before they are bundled into one summary notification instead. 1 always bundles a store's batch; 0 removes the limit and notifies once per game. A bundled summary only opens the panel.

schema.label: Hide seen games
schema.description: Keep each store's list to the games you have not marked seen, followed by a line saying how many were hidden. The footer's eye button toggles the same setting. The headline count still includes the hidden games.

schema.label: Steam
schema.description: Watch Steam. A disabled store is not fetched at all, is hidden from the panel and does not notify.

schema.label: Epic Games Store
schema.description: Watch the Epic Games Store. A disabled store is not fetched at all, is hidden from the panel and does not notify.

schema.label: Epic mobile (Android)
schema.description: Also list Epic's Android weekly free games under the Epic Games heading, marked with an Android glyph. One extra public request per refresh, no account needed. Claiming is in the Epic Games app on a phone.

schema.label: Epic mobile (iOS)
schema.description: Also list Epic's iOS weekly free games under the Epic Games heading, marked with an iOS glyph. One extra public request per refresh, no account needed. Claiming is in the Epic Games app on a phone.

schema.label: GOG
schema.description: Watch GOG. A disabled store is not fetched at all, is hidden from the panel and does not notify.

schema.label: Amazon Luna
schema.description: Off by default. Watch Amazon Luna's free games with Prime by rendering its public claims page in headless Chromium, a base Omarchy package. No account, login or key is needed to watch it; claiming the games needs an Amazon Prime membership. The render costs more than the other stores' single request, so it only runs while this is switched on.

schema.label: Steam notifications
schema.description: Notify when a newly free game appears on Steam. Turn this off to keep watching a store without notifications; the panel shows a crossed-out bell.

schema.label: Epic notifications
schema.description: Notify when a newly free game appears on Epic. Turn this off to keep watching a store without notifications; the panel shows a crossed-out bell.

schema.label: GOG notifications
schema.description: Notify when a newly free game appears on GOG. Turn this off to keep watching a store without notifications; the panel shows a crossed-out bell.

schema.label: Amazon Luna notifications
schema.description: Notify when a newly free game appears on Amazon Luna. Turn this off to keep watching the store without notifications; the panel shows a crossed-out bell.

schema.label: Store country code
schema.description: Optional two-letter store country code (ISO 3166-1: US, DE, GB) used by Steam and Epic. Empty lets each store choose.
